title: Run it twice: does the host converge?
description: Choose a task design and starting host state, then execute repeatedly. Compare Ansible's report with the state and side effects the task actually produces.

hostStates.label: Configuration missing
hostStates.detail: The service file does not exist yet.

hostStates.label: Configuration drifted
hostStates.detail: The file exists, but its contents do not match the reviewed template.

hostStates.label: Already compliant
hostStates.detail: The file already matches the reviewed template exactly.

implementations.label: Declarative template module
implementations.detail: Compare content and metadata, update only on drift, then notify a handler.

implementations.label: Command guarded by creates
implementations.detail: Skip once the file exists. This avoids repetition but cannot detect wrong contents.

implementations.label: Unconditional shell append
implementations.detail: Append configuration text on every execution and report changed every time.
